note: NOT the 1-core/2GiB VPS target. 12 physical cores and ~16 GB RAM. This machine cannot validate the F2 memory budgets (summed worker peak RSS <= 1536 MiB, settled RSS above idle) in any meaningful way: a 2 GiB box is the constraint those budgets exist to catch, and on 16 GB the process never approaches them. Latency and correctness results are still informative; MEMORY numbers measured here are not evidence about the target.
